start_date.description: The start date of the date range for the policy updates in yyyy-MM-dd format.

end_date.description: The end date of the date range for the policy updates in yyyy-MM-dd format.

policy_type.description: The type of policy update. Defaults to 'All' if not specified.

catalog_tools.name: public_apibank_authorizeprescriptionrefill
catalog_tools.description: Authorize a prescription refill request. It has four input parameters: 'prescription_num', 'patient_id', 'pharmacy_name', and 'refill_quantity'. The 'prescription_num' parameter refers to the prescription number that needs to be authorized, 'patient_id' refers to the patient ID who the prescription belongs to, 'pharmacy_name' refers to the name of the pharmacy that will dispense the refill, and 'refill_quantity' specifies the quantity of the refill.

prescription_num.description: The prescription number that needs to be authorized.

patient_id.description: The patient ID who the prescription belongs to.

pharmacy_name.description: The name of the pharmacy that will dispense the refill.

refill_quantity.description: The quantity of the refill. The default value is 1.

catalog_tools.name: public_apibank_get_diagnosis_result
catalog_tools.description: Query diagnosis result for a given patient. This API requires two input parameters: 'patient_id' and 'start_date', where 'patient_id' is a string that represents the ID of the patient and 'start_date' is the date from which to start querying the diagnosis result.

patient_id.description: The ID of the patient

start_date.description: The date from which to start querying the diagnosis result. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

catalog_tools.name: Retrieve Collections
catalog_tools.description: This endpoint provides a list of all the collections supported and vetted by OpenSea. To include all collections relevant to a user (including non-whitelisted ones), set the asset_owner parameter. Each collection in the response has an attribute called primary_asset_contracts with information about the smart contracts belonging to that collection. For example, ERC-1155 contracts may have multiple collections all referencing the same contract, but many ERC-721 contracts may all belong to the same collection (dapp). You can also use this endpoint to find which dapps an account uses and how many items they own in each in a single API call.

asset_owner.description: The owner of the collections to retrieve (optional, default: 0x2bf699087a0d1d67519ba86f960fecd80d59c4d7)

limit.description: The limit for pagination (optional, default: 20)

catalog_tools.name: Get In-Play Fixtures by Sport
catalog_tools.description: Retrieves a tree list of in-play fixtures suitable for constructing a SportBook navigation side menu, including sport, region, competition, and fixtures.

sport_id.description: The ID of the sport for which to retrieve in-play fixtures.

catalog_tools.name: Projected Hitting Stats
catalog_tools.description: Retrieve a player's projected hitting statistics for a given season. If the season parameter is omitted, it returns the actual statistics for the player's earliest major league season.

season.description: Season for which to retrieve projected statistics (optional)
